headword: アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}
gloss: allergic constitution; a tendency to have allergic reactions

definitions.gloss: allergic constitution; a tendency to have allergic reactions
definitions.explanation: A physical constitution or predisposition that makes a person prone to allergic reactions. Often used to describe people who react easily to pollen, foods, or other allergens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}だ。
アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of children with allergic tendencies is increasing.

examples.japanese: アレルギー{体質|たいしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧パッチ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because I have an allergic constitution, I always do a patch test before using new cosmetics.

notes:
Composed of ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧ (allergy, from German "Allergie") and ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (physical constitution, bodily makeup). ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ in Japanese refers to an inherited or long-term physical tendency of the body, not a temporary condition. Saying someone is アレルギー{体質|たいしつ} describes them as generally prone to allergies rather than having one specific allergy.
